description: Switch thrown under a train running facing through it (#289 review 2b): as eu07_td_switch_facing_control, but the way is set to track 2 (keyctrl01) and zwr01 is thrown to track 1 when the locomotive has run onto the switch with both its bogies (event of the switch track, set off by its rear axle). The locomotive keeps the way it ran onto and goes on to track 2; the first coach comes to the points after the throw and takes track 1: it and the locomotive run forked, and physics.derailment monitor tells in the log that the coach derails (the coupled ends 0.45 m apart sideways). The AI scans its route again from the switch, along the way of the locomotive, and stops before the exit signal of track 2.
